notes:
What’s new in DriveDeck 0.20.5

• Added live surrounding traffic, road lanes, sidewalks, barriers, signs, traffic lights and optional scenery to Model S and Model Three.
• Added driving-view quality options and controls for render distance and turn-camera frame rate.
• Improved concrete-barrier continuity and visualizer performance with cached geometry and background processing.
• Turn cameras now run only while a supported live driving deck is visible, and stop when DriveDeck closes.
• Added Stability and Plaid Stability displays, animated drivetrain wheels and improved display selection.
• Improved mobile scenery, shared driving-view settings, dashboard refresh and automatic screen-awake handling.
• Refined sidewalk surfaces, navigation guidance and Martin’s animated album artwork.

With BeamNG fully closed, use Connect → Install companion to update the bundled companion before restarting the game. Scenery coverage depends on the map’s available data; some objects may be missing or approximate. Existing settings are preserved.

Windows also gains notification banners with app icons and Phone Link support. Notification access is optional and can be enabled in Display settings.
